SELECT pg_catalog.pg_class.oid, pg_catalog.pg_class.relname, pg_catalog.pg_class.reloptions, NULL AS relhasoids, CASE WHEN (pg_catalog.pg_am.amname IS NOT NULL AND pg_catalog.pg_am.amname != current_setting($1::VARCHAR)) THEN pg_catalog.pg_am.amname ELSE NULL END AS access_method_name, pg_catalog.pg_tablespace.spcname AS tablespace_name, inherits.parent_table_names 
FROM pg_catalog.pg_class LEFT OUTER JOIN pg_catalog.pg_am ON pg_catalog.pg_class.relam = pg_catalog.pg_am.oid LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT pg_catalog.pg_inherits.inhrelid AS inhrelid, array_agg(pg_catalog.pg_class.relname ORDER BY pg_catalog.pg_inherits.inhseqno) AS parent_table_names 
FROM pg_catalog.pg_inherits JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class ON pg_catalog.pg_inherits.inhparent = pg_catalog.pg_class.oid GROUP BY pg_catalog.pg_inherits.inhrelid) AS inherits ON pg_catalog.pg_class.oid = inherits.inhrelid LEFT OUTER JOIN pg_catalog.pg_tablespace ON pg_catalog.pg_tablespace.oid = pg_catalog.pg_class.reltablespace JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace ON pg_catalog.pg_namespace.oid = pg_catalog.pg_class.relnamespace 
WHERE pg_catalog.pg_class.relkind = ANY (ARRAY[$2::VARCHAR, $3::VARCHAR, $4::VARCHAR, $5::VARCHAR, $6::VARCHAR]) AND pg_catalog.pg_namespace.nspname = $7::VARCHAR AND pg_catalog.pg_class.relname IN ($8::VARCHAR)

SELECT pg_catalog.pg_class.oid, pg_catalog.pg_class.relname, pg_catalog.pg_class.reloptions, NULL AS relhasoids, CASE WHEN (pg_catalog.pg_am.amname IS NOT NULL AND pg_catalog.pg_am.amname != current_setting('default_table_access_method'::VARCHAR)) THEN pg_catalog.pg_am.amname ELSE NULL END AS access_method_name, pg_catalog.pg_tablespace.spcname AS tablespace_name, inherits.parent_table_names 
FROM pg_catalog.pg_class LEFT OUTER JOIN pg_catalog.pg_am ON pg_catalog.pg_class.relam = pg_catalog.pg_am.oid LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT pg_catalog.pg_inherits.inhrelid AS inhrelid, array_agg(pg_catalog.pg_class.relname ORDER BY pg_catalog.pg_inherits.inhseqno) AS parent_table_names 
FROM pg_catalog.pg_inherits JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class ON pg_catalog.pg_inherits.inhparent = pg_catalog.pg_class.oid GROUP BY pg_catalog.pg_inherits.inhrelid) AS inherits ON pg_catalog.pg_class.oid = inherits.inhrelid LEFT OUTER JOIN pg_catalog.pg_tablespace ON pg_catalog.pg_tablespace.oid = pg_catalog.pg_class.reltablespace JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace ON pg_catalog.pg_namespace.oid = pg_catalog.pg_class.relnamespace 
WHERE pg_catalog.pg_class.relkind = ANY (ARRAY['r'::VARCHAR, 'p'::VARCHAR, 'f'::VARCHAR, 'v'::VARCHAR, 'm'::VARCHAR]) AND pg_catalog.pg_namespace.nspname = 'demo'::VARCHAR AND pg_catalog.pg_class.relname IN ('trips'::VARCHAR)
